description: Log a new meat processing batch and record the resulting cuts to freezer inventory. Requires farmId and apiKey authorization.

batchId.description: Optional unique batch/hatch ID associated with these birds

confirm.description: Set to true to persist the write, otherwise returns a dry-run preview

date.description: Date processed in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique client-provided key to prevent duplicate processing

part.description: The cut/part type (e.g., Whole Bird, Breast, Leg). Will be validated against configured farm parts if set.

quantity.description: Positive integer quantity of units processed

totalWeight.description: Optional total weight of the batch (used to calculate average weight)

variety.description: The species or breed variety processed (e.g., Jumbo Coturnix)

weightPerUnit.description: Optional average weight per processed unit

name: log_meat
